Alaska and American are essentially tied (~4 bps apart).

## Conclusion

No — the top-ranked airline differs. **Alaska Air Group** leads on revenue growth (+12.6%, aided by the Hawaiian acquisition), while **Delta Air Lines** leads on FY2024 operating margin (9.7%). American is notable as the only carrier whose operating income declined year over year ($3,034M → $2,614M) despite revenue growth [DOC-1].

ANSWER: No. Revenue growth rank: Alaska (+12.6%), United (+6.2%), Delta (+6.2%), Southwest (+5.3%), American (+2.7%). FY2024 operating margin rank: Delta (9.7%), United (8.9%), Alaska (4.86%), American (4.82%), Southwest (1.2%). Alaska tops growth; Delta tops margin.
